title: deterministic staged indexer and anchored attestations for airgapped rollouts
author: Priya Menon
description:
Motivation: Airgapped and VPC/private deployments need deterministic, auditable release artifacts that can be staged and rolled out safely across disconnected environments. This PR adds a deterministic staged indexer that emits canonical delta indices, plus an anchored attestation flow that ties signed delta blobs to a stable TUF anchor file. The goal is to make offline upgrade/rollback plans reproducible and verifiable by operators and audits.

What this changes (high level):
- New CLI: 'installer indexer build-staged' produces staged_release.json + per-stage delta-indexes in deterministic order.
- Canonical metadata: artifact metadata is normalized (timestamp rounding, sorted artifact keys, stable hash ordering) to ensure reproducible indices across builds.
- Anchored attestations: cosign-based attestations are produced and then referenced from a small TUF anchor file that lives alongside the index; this anchor is the minimal trust root the installer checks in airgapped upgrades.
- Helm chart helper: small chart annotation changes to encode index fingerprint for preflight checks in the private installer.
- Terraform module: variable inputs and output for embedding index anchor fingerprints into upstream automation.
- CI pipeline: new pipeline job that performs two successive builds (repro build + verification build) to detect non-determinism and surface flaky packaging steps.

Checklist: [x] indexer implementation with unit tests, [x] cosign attestation generation and verification, [x] helm annotations and preflight hook, [x] terraform variable + docs updates, [x] CI double-build verification job, [x] integration test against offline installer image.

Commits (summary):
- add: staged indexer CLI and core engine (indexer/staged_indexer.go, cmd/indexer/main.go)
- feat: canonical metadata normalizer and serializer (indexer/normalizer.go)
- feat: cosign attestation producer + TUF anchor writer (attest/anchor_writer.go)
- chore: helm annotation helper and preflight check (charts/installer/templates/_helpers.tpl, charts/installer/templates/preflight-hook.yaml)
- feat: terraform module inputs/outputs for index anchors (terraform/modules/installer-index/main.tf)
- ci: new pipeline job 'indexer-repro-verify' (ci/pipelines/indexer-repro-verify.yaml)

Files changed (high-level):
- indexer/staged_indexer.go
- indexer/normalizer.go
- attest/anchor_writer.go
- cmd/indexer/main.go
- charts/installer/values.yaml (annotation defaults)
- charts/installer/templates/preflight-hook.yaml
- terraform/modules/installer-index/main.tf
- ci/pipelines/indexer-repro-verify.yaml
- test/integration/offline-indexer-test.sh

Testing and verification: unit tests added for deterministic ordering and normalization; integration test spins up a local staging dir, runs the indexer twice and verifies bit-for-bit equality of produced staged_release.json and all delta shards. CI pipeline runs the double-build: first build produces artifacts, second build (in a clean container) re-produces them and runs 'cmp' on the outputs; non-zero diffs fail the job and upload a diagnostic bundle.

Security and provenance notes: attest/anchor_writer.go produces a minimal TUF anchor JSON that references cosign signatures and a canonical artifact list. The installer client was updated to check the anchor signature chain before accepting staged indexes when --require-anchor is set. This keeps the default lightweight but enables strict enforcement in regulated environments.

Backward compatibility and rollout: index format is backwards-compatible; installer will continue to accept legacy indices but will emit warnings. The staged indices are additive; operators can opt-in per-release using the --staged flag in the release pipeline. Terraform and Helm changes are optional and guarded by variables.

Related: references SUP-7312 for a customer request to provide verifiable airgapped rollouts and ENG-2149 for general reproducibility work.

review_thread: Diego Alvarez: Please ensure the normalizer preserves deterministic ordering for both map and list fields — saw a potential nondeterminism in artifact tag sorting.
Priya Menon: Added deterministic comparator and explicit stable sort for tags; unit tests added (indexer/normalizer_test.go).

Priya Menon: Fixed Dockerfile and added a clean workspace step in ci/pipelines/indexer-repro-verify.yaml; re-ran pipeline and it passed.
Ethan Wu: Anchor format looks good; would like a short doc blurb on how operators rotate cosign keys and how that impacts anchors.

release_notes: Introduces deterministic staged indexer and anchored attestation flow for airgapped/private rollouts. Operators can generate reproducible delta indices and verify them via a minimal TUF anchor tied to cosign signatures. Optional Helm and Terraform helpers included for easier adoption.
